name: isabelle-revamp
description: Isabelle/HOL in stock VS Code using the installed Isabelle language server.

isabelleRevamp.prettySymbols.description: Display ASCII Isabelle symbols as mathematics; reveal source at the cursor. Does not change the file or source coordinates.

isabelleRevamp.symbolRewrite.description: Rewrite ASCII input as you type, outside comments: \name followed by a terminator becomes \<name> when name is exactly a symbol, except the one-letter bold alphabet (\n, \t stay escapes), inside a string within a cartouche (an ML string) and inside the cartouche of an ML or document command (text, section, …), where \in is LaTeX; << at the start of a token becomes \<open>; >> becomes \<close> after an unclosed \<open> on the same line or at the start of a token outside a quoted string. The file stays ASCII.

isabelleRevamp.decorations.semanticColou.description: Colour free, bound and type variables, keywords, numerals and comments with Isabelle's own markup colours, as jEdit does, wherever the server has checked the text. The grammar colours the rest.

isabelleRevamp.decorations.processingBac.description: Shade the commands Isabelle has not yet checked or is still running. Failed and admitted commands keep their red shade.

isabelleRevamp.decorations.theoremMarks.description: Mark every theorem in the gutter: a double tick once proved, a warning sign when admitted with sorry or oops, a cross on an error, a dotted circle while checking.

isabelleRevamp.executable.description: Path to the Isabelle executable (~/ is supported), or isabelle on PATH. Reload the window after changing this setting.

isabelleRevamp.lockLibrary.description: Open files under ISABELLE_HOME and ISABELLE_HOME_USER (HOL, HOL-Analysis and ML sources reached by Ctrl-click) read-only for this session. For a permanent lock use files.readonlyInclude.

enumDescriptions: Open the Isabelle Goals panel beside the editor when the first theory becomes active.
Reveal the Isabelle Goals view in the Explorer sidebar instead.
isabelleRevamp.goalsPanel.description: Where the goals appear automatically when a theory opens. Isabelle: Open Goals Beside Editor opens the panel at any time.
